_fixture_source: copy of smart-memory-docs docs/features/WEB-VECTOR-SEARCH-TAB-1/vector-contract.json at origin/main (VEC-TAB-U3, 2026-10-21); CI has no docs checkout, so tests/test_local_api_vector.py reads this copy. Re-copy when the contract changes.

principles.backend_neutral: Every field here is produced through smartmemory.stores.vector.backends.base.VectorBackend. No route, delegate, SDK or UI may name FalkorDB or USearch; `backend` is an opaque string the backend reports about itself.
principles.read_only: All routes are reads. The only write-adjacent action (reindex) stays on the existing /memory/reindex path and is NOT part of this contract.
principles.scoped: Every count, hit and item is in-scope for the caller's MemoryScopeProvider (workspace by default, user under USER isolation). Collection-wide totals are reported only when the backend declares `single_tenant: true` (Lite USearch).

request.text: string | null — embedded server-side with the configured embedder; exactly one of text / embedding is required
request.embedding: number[] | null — raw query vector; must match space.dimension or 400
request.top_k: integer, default 10, max 50 (server clamps, never rejects)
request.memory_type: string | null — equality filter on hit.memory_type
request.origin_prefix: string | null — prefix filter on hit.origin (same semantics as search(origin=...))
request.collection: string, default "memory" — a collection name from stats.collections[].name; unknown -> 404
request.include_embedding: boolean, default false — when true each hit carries `embedding_preview` (first 16 floats), never the full vector

response.hits: VectorHit[] (ordered by score desc, length <= top_k)
response.truncated: boolean — true when the backend candidate ceiling was hit before top_k in-scope hits were found

response.single_tenant: boolean — true when the collection holds only this scope's rows (Lite)

capabilities.missing_list: boolean — backend implements missing_vector_ids(); false means /missing returns 501

embedder.dimension: integer | null — configured dimension (probe), null when the embedder is unavailable

response.warnings: string[] — e.g. dimension drift between embedder.dimension and a collection's index dimension

response.neighbours: VectorHit[] — excludes the item itself, ordered by score desc

errors.404: item not visible to the caller, or no vector row (body.detail = "no_vector" when the memory exists but has no embedding)

request.cursor: string | null — opaque, from the previous page's next_cursor

response.total: integer | null — in-scope count of missing rows when the backend can count cheaply, else null

errors.501: backend does not implement missing_vector_ids (stats.capabilities.missing_list = false)

SpaceRef.model_id: string | null — the model the collection's vectors were written with when the backend records it (USearch state model_id), else null
SpaceRef.dimension: integer | null — the live index dimension (FalkorVectorBackend.live_index_dimension / USearch Index.ndim)

CollectionStats.name: string — "memory" (StoreConfig.embed content vectors) or the structure-aware collection; names come from the backend, never hard-coded in clients
CollectionStats.count: integer — in-scope vector rows (scoped_count when supported, else post-filtered count)
CollectionStats.index_count: integer | null — collection-wide rows; present only when single_tenant
CollectionStats.missing_count: integer | null — in-scope memories with no usable vector, null when uncounted

VectorHit.score: number — similarity in [0, 1], higher is better (FalkorDB cosine distance is normalised 1 - d; USearch cosine likewise)
VectorHit.title: string | null
VectorHit.snippet: string | null — first 200 chars of content, in-scope memory join; null when the vector row has no graph twin
VectorHit.has_graph_node: boolean — false marks an orphan vector (row without a memory node)

VectorItem.title: string | null
VectorItem.content: string | null — full content from the memory node (scope-checked)

vector.metadata: object — the stored vector metadata minus the embedding and minus tenant/user/workspace ids

MissingItem.reason: "no_row" | "row_without_vector" | "type_not_searchable" — the last comes from embedding_policy.type_is_searchable and is informational, not a defect

errors.400: neither or both of text/embedding; embedding dimension != space.dimension (detail names both numbers)
errors.403: scope error (X-SM-Scope-Error header, same as other routes)
errors.404: unknown collection; item not visible; no vector row
errors.501: capability not implemented by the active backend (never silently empty)
errors.503: VectorSubstrateError from the backend is surfaced, never converted to an empty page (CORE-VECTOR-SPACE-1)

backend_abc_additions.describe(): -> VectorBackendInfo{backend, single_tenant, dimension, model_id, count, capabilities}; abstract-with-default: base returns backend=class name, dimension/model_id None, count=self.count()
backend_abc_additions.missing_vector_ids(limit, cursor): -> (ids, next_cursor); base raises NotImplementedError (reported as capability false, never an empty list)
